title: io.loams.dev.usage.postgres.compute.v1
description: The `data` of a `io.loams.dev.usage.postgres.compute.v1` usage event: A running Postgres compute, every 60 s and at suspend. Producer: ComputeLifecycleObserver plus a ticker (pg-control). Design §63 §6.3. Measured values are integers in the unit named; dimensions are strings. New optional fields may be added within v1.
